items.text: Hi, I'm Rowan! Heads up for the potluck: I'm allergic to peanuts, so nothing with peanut please.
Whole Foods order: organic spinach, organic strawberries, oat milk.
I love cilantro, put it on everything.
Folgers is my favorite brand, grabbed two more tubs of the classic roast.
Dinner at Thai Basil with Sam.
Safeway order: organic bananas, Folgers classic roast ground coffee.
Bought Reese's peanut butter cups (gift for Sam's birthday).
Farmers market: pick up organic produce for the week.
Honestly I can't stand cilantro anymore, it tastes like soap to me now.
Whole Foods order: organic blueberries, organic greek yogurt.
Still allergic to peanuts, please check the labels at the party.
